name: velocity-marquee
title: 滚动速度跑马灯 Velocity Marquee
description: 跑马灯根据滚动速度加速，并随滚动方向反转。

props.name: children
props.description: Items repeated across the seamless track.

props.name: baseSpeed
props.description: Idle track speed in pixels per second.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Added speed for each pixel per second of scroll velocity.

props.name: maxBoost
props.description: Maximum velocity-driven speed boost in pixels per second.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between repeated groups in pixels.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Invert the base and scroll-driven direction.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

props.name: groupClassName
props.description: Classes applied to each repeated group.

usage: `VelocityMarquee` 保留持续的基础速度，同时读取页面或指定容器的滚动速度来增加推进量和改变方向。内部只渲染两个无缝组，第二组从辅助技术中隐藏。
